card.name: The word International in organization names
card.fires_on: The word "International" (or "international") right after "the", "an" or "of", especially when it begins the name of a body such as a tribunal, committee or collaboration. It also fires on the "Ball" in the surname Ballings.

modes.label: International bodies
modes.description: "International" after "the" or "an", opening the name of a committee, tribunal, center or agreement.

modes.description: The first part of the name Ballings in Flora of Zimbabwe credits.
